concept: CloudFront + WAF: low latency and DDoS/web-exploit protection
tests: The combination for delivering content with minimal latency and protecting the origin from DDoS and L7 attacks.
expected: CloudFront in front of the origin (edge cache, built-in Shield Standard) + AWS WAF on the distribution (SQLi, XSS, rate-based rules). Triggers: "lowest latency", "protect origin from DDoS", "common web exploits".
why_not: A single large EC2 origin gives neither latency nor protection; Cognito — authentication; Direct Connect — private connectivity, not content delivery.
